title: Cardiac POCUS for Critical Care Fellows
text: This curriculum is built for critical care fellows learning point-of-care echocardiography. Six modules, organized around the clinical questions you’ll actually ask at the bedside.

Organized by finding, not by diagnosis.

Small effusion
Loops and teaching points coming soon.

Loops and teaching points coming soon.


Tamponade physiology
Loops and teaching points coming soon — RA collapse, RV diastolic collapse, plethoric IVC, respiratory variation.


Loculated effusion
Loops and teaching points coming soon.


Mimics & pitfalls
Pleural effusion vs pericardial, fat pad vs effusion, descending aorta vs effusion.

title: Cardiac POCUS for Critical Care Fellows
text: This curriculum is built for critical care fellows learning point-of-care echocardiography. Six modules, organized around the clinical questions you’ll actually ask at the bedside.

title: Cardiac POCUS for Critical Care Fellows
text:
How to use this site
Work through the modules in order. Each module has the same five parts:

Clinical question — what bedside decision this exam answers
Image acquisition — probe, windows, and technique
Normal & normal variants — the baseline you need before pathology
Pathology library — organized by finding, not by diagnosis
Integration cases — where the finding changes management

Each module also has a linked Anki deck for spaced-repetition review and a quiz to check your understanding.

title: Cardiac POCUS for Critical Care Fellows
text:
Modules

Module 1 — Windows & Image Acquisition
Module 2 — Left Ventricular Function
Module 3 — Right Ventricular Function
Module 4 — Pericardium
Module 5 — IVC & Volume Status
Module 6 — Shock & Arrest Integration
